_help: Content for the archived Harvard Jiu-Jitsu Club pages (legacy/bjj/). Edited by alumni through alumni.html. 'boards' is one entry per academic year, newest first. 'stories' are shown newest first; 'body' may contain blank lines for paragraphs. 'photoCaptions' maps a filename in photos/legacy/ to an optional caption.

stories.title: Two clubs become one
stories.author: HCSC E-Board
stories.body:
In fall 2026 the Harvard Jiu-Jitsu Club joined forces with the Harvard Women's Wrestling Club to form the Harvard Combat Sports Club. This page preserves the Jiu-Jitsu Club's own site as it was, and gives alumni a place to add their memories.

If you trained with the club, we'd love to hear from you: use the Alumni login at the bottom of the page to add a story or fill in a past board.
